name: pronoun_case
description: Choose subject, object, or possessive English pronoun for a specified person/group in a sentence; control copies an unrelated given tag.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
forms={'male':('he','him','his'),'female':('she','her','her'),'plural':('they','them','their')}
refs={'male':'the man','female':'the woman','plural':'the people'}
frames=[(0,'___ arrived early.'),(0,'___ opened the door.'),(0,'___ will help tomorrow.'),(1,'I spoke to ___.'),(1,'We invited ___.'),(1,'The teacher thanked ___.'),(2,'This is ___ book.'),(2,'I found ___ keys.'),(2,'We visited ___ house.')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(108):
 typ=list(forms)[i%3]; case,s=random.choice(frames); tag=random.choice(['red','blue','green','gold']); ans=forms[typ][case]
 context=f'Tag: {tag}. The blank refers to {refs[typ]}.\nSentence: {s}'
 items.append({'prompt':context+'\nFill the blank with the correct English pronoun, in lowercase.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'\nCopy the tag word.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
